description.p: Pet-GPT emulates five Commodore PET and CBM models - the original PET 2001, the 2001N/3000, the 4000 with 9-inch and 12-inch screens, and the 80-column CBM 8032 - with tape and disk images, CB2 sound, SNES user-port gamepads and an OpenGL CRT monitor look.

Pet-GPT ships no ROMs. Put your own PET ROM sets, programs and disk images in the Pet-GPT folder in your home directory, which is created the first time Pet-GPT runs: ~/Pet-GPT/roms (one folder per model), ~/Pet-GPT/files (the emulated drive 8) and ~/Pet-GPT/screenshots. On SteamOS that is /home/deck/Pet-GPT. Settings are kept separately, so resetting them never touches anything there.
Pause and PNG screenshots, stable monitor selection on Windows, a visible ~/Pet-GPT folder on Linux, AltGr typing on international keyboards, and smoother sound after a hitch.
